'''Mack''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Mack was assigned to fly [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]], [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and several [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in order to deliver a ransom in the form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|group of]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had captured the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Unknown to the Republic, [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], the second man in the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, cooperated with fellow pirate [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] to betray the group's leader, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], and steal the spice. Upon arriving in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Florrum, the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Republic shuttle]] was ambushed by Mentir in a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class Weequay ship]]. Mentir attacked the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with his [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and with two [[Missile/Legends|rockets]]. Due to interference by Binks, who accidentally removed Mack from his seat in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], the rockets hit the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], sending it crashing into the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]] on Florrum. The impact [[Death/Legends|killed]] Mack, [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Florrum)|his partner pilot]] and Kharrus, but the rest of the team survived.

==Biography==
[[File:MackTangledWithJarJar-TGG.png|thumb|left|250px|Mack disentangles himself from the troublesome Binks]]
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who adopted the nickname Mack was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], which were born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was captured by a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|group of]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Ohnaka contacted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and agreed to hand Dooku over to the Republic for a ransom of one million credits' worth of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="TCWGungan" />

Mack was one of the pilots assigned to fly [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Binks]] to deliver the spice ransom to [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. He was killed when the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] he was co-piloting was shot down by a rogue member of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka's gang]].<ref name="TCWGungan" />

==Personality and traits==
Although Mack was a trained clone trooper pilot, he was unable to evade the rockets launched by Mentir due to the interference of Binks.<ref name="TCWGungan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mack was first featured in "[[The Gungan General]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the ''Clone Wars'' TV series]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers in the series.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref>
